iur.description: Percentage of urgent or critical tasks that have been completed. Those still pending count as unattended. Goal: ≥85%.

iosInstall.title: Install Nexxus to get notifications on your iPhone or iPad
iosInstall.step1: Tap the Share button (square with an up arrow) in Safari.
iosInstall.step3: Open Nexxus from the new icon on your home screen.
iosInstall.step4: Come back to Settings → Notifications and turn them on.
iosInstall.note: On iPhone they only work if you open Nexxus from the home screen, not from Safari.

inApp.message: Open Nexxus in Safari or Chrome to enable notifications.
